author: COURIER
text: At 38 two residents stand accused — the two lowest — and one leaves. Today that line falls at Mercer 119 and Juniper 114, but a door still hides 25 points, and one opened door redraws who stands there. Two factions form first; a faction that votes as one pays each of its voters 5. Votes are secret, and the accused vote too.
